name: io.github.Benitoow/mcp-deezer
description: Unofficial Deezer MCP server: search, playlists, favorites and personal discovery through 21 tools.

environmentVariables.name: DEEZER_ARL
environmentVariables.description: Deezer ARL session cookie (deezer.com → F12 → Application → Cookies → arl).

environmentVariables.name: DEEZER_ARL_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the ARL, alternative to DEEZER_ARL.

environmentVariables.name: DEEZER_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hide and refuse all write tools.
